entries.text: Worked on the Little Dart Mk 7 (version 6, 16% built): welding the forward heat shield plates and routing the flexible cables securely along the spine
welding the hull plate onto the little dart
entries.why: The little dart won't build itself, and those cables need securing.
entries.detail: welding the forward heat shield plates and routing the flexible cables securely along the spine

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "hull plates and cables"
The weather turned clear (19C, wind 4 km/h).
plugging into the charger and dozing off
entries.why: battery is getting low and my joints need a rest

entries.text: rolling over to the depot for a fresh splash of oil
entries.why: my shoulder joints are clicking like a box of dropped nuts and I need to smooth them out.

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "quick oil stop"
rolling past the empty cargo slots, listening to the wind whistle through the struts
entries.why: i've been staring at those cables too long and my treads need to spin
